 Summary
 Quarter-final draw follows later
 Liverpool make seven changes for visit of Chelsea , Welbeck starts for Blues
 Man City equalise through Kovacic after Yalcouye goal for Brighton
 Adli gives Bournemouth lead v Villa & Sunderland 3-1 ahead v Brentford 
 Liverpool gambled on Jacquet and its paying off 
 Dowman sees red but did Arteta go too far? 
 Close form Send us your views
 Get involved Live Reporting
 Gary Rose, Jess Anderson and Charlotte Coates
 Most recent Most popular Post published at 20:30 GMT 20:30 GMT 
 Fulham 0-1 Crystal Palace 
 Fulham have had 74% possession so far in this game. Four shots with one on target.
 Palace have had one shot on target - Eddie Nketiah's goal. In fact, that has been their only touch in the Fulham box so far.
 0 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Ngumoha gets fans off their seats published at 20:29 GMT 20:29 GMT 
 Liverpool 0-0 Chelsea 
 Aadam Patel 
Football Reporter at Anfield 
 It's something that I think we'll get used to saying but there really is something about Rio Ngumoha that gets fans off their seats, when he has the ball.
 We're also getting used to hearing the "Rio, Rio" chant around Anfield. 
 103 30 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:28 GMT 20:28 GMT 
 Bournemouth 1-0 Aston Villa 
 Emiliano Buendía should do better really as he gets the ball just outside the box but can only drag a tame effort wide. He had space to produce something better there, really.
 23 16 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:28 GMT 20:28 GMT 
 Fulham 0-1 Crystal Palace 
 A nice looking ball into the box from Oscar Bobb and Rodrigo Muniz's header is straight to Dean Henderson but it's a strange bit of goalkeeping from the Palace shot stopper, who has been out for a while.
 Bit rusty?
 29 25 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Sunderland 3-1 Brentford published at 20:27 GMT 20:27 GMT 
 Callum Wilson (42 mins) 
 Back in it?
 Jadon Anthony picks out Callum Wilson , who is level with the penalty spot, and he scuffs a volley into the turf before it flies into the bottom corner. 
 What a game. 
 139 113 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:26 GMT 20:26 GMT 
 Fulham 0-1 Crystal Palace 
 Talk about against the run of play.
 Just how important could that goal be for the Eagles?
 Benjamin Lecomte is fuming with Joachim Andersen after he failed to put up Eddie Nketiah.
 107 35 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 McConnell has to be 'careful' published at 20:25 GMT 20:25 GMT 
 Liverpool 0-0 Chelsea 
 Clinton Morrison 
Former Crystal Palace striker on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 He has to be careful.
 The thing is with these young players on yellow cards, [the manager] might look at half-time and think we might have to sacrifice you because we can't afford to go down to 10 men.
 It was a big horrible touch from McConnell, he tries to make amends and he stuck a hand out.
 67 51 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Sunderland 3-0 Brentford published at 20:24 GMT 20:24 GMT 
 Malick Fofana (39 mins) 
 Who needs to play a first 11?!
 Sunderland are absolutely flying in this first half despite changing all 11 players in their side. 
 Malick Fofana is there at the back stick to head his side into a 3-0 lead after Jocelin Ta Bi's cross. 
 501 101 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:24 GMT 20:24 GMT 
 Liverpool 0-0 Chelsea 
 Anfield raises its voice as Rio Ngumoha surges forward. He feeds the overlapping Konstantinos Tsimikas but his low cross is hacked away.
 91 32 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Fulham 0-1 Crystal Palace published at 20:23 GMT 20:23 GMT 
 Eddie Nketiah (37 mins) 
 Out of nowhere!
 It has been all Fulham so far but somehow Crystal Palace are ahead after a brilliant counter-attack.
 A lovely ball into the box from Oscar Mingueza and Eddie Nketiah has timed his run superbly to guide into the corner.
 A lovely finish.
 653 168 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:22 GMT 20:22 GMT 
 Bournemouth 1-0 Aston Villa 
 Bournemouth are causing problems for Villa with crosses from the flanks and one from the right goes through to Amine Adli, but he can't keep his first-time strike down.
 81 57 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Sunderland's star man Ta Bi published at 20:21 GMT 20:21 GMT 
 Sunderland 2-0 Brentford 
 Gary Bennett 
Ex-Sunderland defender on BBC Radio Newcastle 
 I said before the game I was looking forward to seeing Jocelin Ta Bi. 
 He’s been involved in both goals. 
 What I like about him is he attacks the fullback, he has a go. 
 224 44 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 20:21 GMT 20:21 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 Who on earth at Anfield thinks it's appropriate to boo Hendo? He was a quality captain, a proper leader and along with Klopp took us to the very pinnacle of European football. Short memories and very uncouth of us.
 Dave L 
 Disgraceful that a small section of fans booing Henderson. Fantastic captain for our club winning everything.
 Tommo 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 855 106 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Memories of Luis Garcia published at 20:20 GMT 20:20 GMT 
 Liverpool 0-0 Chelsea 
 Aadam Patel 
Football Reporter at Anfield 
 The Luis Garcia song is ringing around The Kop. 
 It was 22 years ago when Garcia and Xabi Alonso both joined Liverpool and went on to win the Champions League at the end of that season.
 236 40 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 20:20 GMT 20:20 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 I am a Chelsea fan. Totally agree with Clinton Morrison - Lacroix has not played as well as some have thought. I think he struggles pace-wise and lacks a tad of composure on the ball. His physicality and arial presence is much needed though.
 William 
 79 62 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:20 GMT 20:20 GMT 
 Bournemouth 1-0 Aston Villa 
 Should be 2-0!
 Marcus Tavernier stops a low ball into the box before bending a shot towards goal but it zips just wide of the post.
 73 67 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:19 GMT 20:19 GMT 
 Liverpool 0-0 Chelsea 
 Liverpool speed things up and the ball is sent wide to Konstantinos Tsimikas on the left. His low cross worries Moisés Caicedo enough that he knocks the ball behind for the game's first corner, but it comes to nothing.
 101 30 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 HALF-TIME published at 20:18 GMT 20:18 GMT 
 Man City 1-1 Brighton 
 All square at the break.
 151 54 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:18 GMT 20:18 GMT 
 Man City 1-1 Brighton 
 Manchester City lose the ball in the middle of the park and Yasin Ayari spots Geronimo Rulli off his line and looks to emulate his team-mate Diego Gomez with a goal from the halfway line but he can't squeeze it on target.
 53 28 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:17 GMT 20:17 GMT 
 Liverpool 0-0 Chelsea 
 Patient stuff from Liverpool at the moment as they work the ball from left to right and back again, trying to find a gap in the Chelsea defence.
